newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremer Vulkan cost Bremen 600 mln marks - officials.
newsitem.headline: Bremer Vulkan cost Bremen 600 mln marks - officials.

text.p: The German city-state of Bremen paid out nearly 600 million marks ($400 million at current rates) between 1984 and 1989 to help develop shipbuilder Bremen Vulkan, two senior officials of the state's finance office said on Wednesday.

The money for the shipyards in Bremen and Bremerhaven came in the form of state guarantees and subsidies, the two officials said before the committee, set up by the Bremen government, to examine the collapse of the shipyard.
The alternative to providing the subsidies was risk losing all the jobs at the shipyards.
This would have led to an unemployment rate of 25 percent around where the ship building docks were based, which seemed too much to cope with at the time, the finance officials told the committee.
